A public interest consumer advocacy NGO challenged the advertisement, submitting dermatologist evidence proving that skin pigmentation cannot be medically altered by 3 shades in 7 days by a topical cream, violating Chapter I (Truthful and Honest Representations) of the ASCI Code. Furthermore, the complaint alleged that depicting darker skin as a social disability and lighter skin as the key to professional success promoted toxic colorism and violated Chapter II (Decency).
